title: SequenceOperation
description: Structural contract for work a sequence step can wait on and own: anything with a `poll` method, waited on with `yield* context.waitFor(operation)`. Adapting a native action takes a function that returns such an object, not a class; tweenOperation is the adapter for a Tween. ```ts const voiceEnded = (voice: Voice): SequenceOperation => { let ended = false; const onEnd = (): void => { ended = true; }; voice.onEnd.add(onEnd); return { poll: () => (ended ? { status: 'completed', value: undefined } : undefined), cancel: () => { voice.onEnd.remove(onEnd); voice.stop(); }, }; }; ```

sections.title: Import
paragraphs: Structural contract for work a sequence step can wait on and own: anything with a `poll` method, waited on with `yield* context.waitFor(operation)`. Adapting a native action takes a function that returns such an object, not a class; tweenOperation is the adapter for a Tween.
```ts const voiceEnded = (voice: Voice): SequenceOperation => { let ended = false; const onEnd = (): void => { ended = true; };
return { poll: () => (ended ? { status: 'completed', value: undefined } : undefined), cancel: () => { voice.onEnd.remove(onEnd); voice.stop(); }, }; }; ```

members.name: cancel
members.description: Stop the work. Called at most once, synchronously, when the waiting step stops waiting before poll reported a settlement: the step was cancelled, lost a race, failed through one of its branches, or its sequencer was torn down. Never called after a settlement.

members.name: poll
members.description: Report whether the work has ended. Called once per tick of the sequencer while a step waits, first on the tick after the wait began, with that tick's delta. Return undefined while the work is still running. A cancelled settlement throws a SequenceCancelledError into the waiting step, a failed one throws its error, and a throwing poll counts as failed.
